researchQuestion: Can vocabulary and a weakly supervised pattern be incrementally extended, combined on held-out combinations, corrected, persisted, and retained without resetting earlier knowledge?

conditions.A: Fresh isolated vocabulary and pattern state.
conditions.B: Exact example retrieval from the same labeled training examples.
conditions.C: Existing TransInfant vocabulary learner with incremental teaching, no pattern application.
conditions.D: Same staged facts plus induced pattern and composition.
conditions.E: Correction/revision sequence compared with a no-correction control.

patternAlgorithm: The bounded six-permutation weakly supervised inducer in Experiment 004. Pattern changes are revisions rebuilt from the explicit evidence set; a contradictory set abstains rather than silently changing the accepted rule.
sequenceDesign: A then B then C then D then E then F then G
B then A then C then D then E then F then G

metrics.retention: Number of previously supported vocabulary queries still supported / number tested.
metrics.forgetting: max(0, pre-interference accuracy - post-interference accuracy), in absolute accuracy points.
metrics.transfer: Exact concept-ID frames on held-out combinations whose words and learned pattern were taught in different phases.
metrics.correctionSuccess: Correct target mapping after explicit feedback / explicit feedback corrections attempted.
metrics.revertCorrectness: Reverted snapshot's queried mapping equals the immediately prior version's mapping.
metrics.contradictionRate: Rejected conflicting updates / conflicting non-feedback updates attempted.
metrics.restartRetention: Post-process-restart frame predictions identical to pre-restart predictions / predictions tested.
metrics.memoryGrowth: UTF-8 bytes in the isolated JSON knowledge store after each phase.

claims: The curriculum is synthetic. No significance test or broad continual-learning claim is planned.
